empty.reason: The home content entry is required; index.astro throws without it, so a zero-content home cannot occur.

single.reason: Home renders one fixed composition, not a list; there is no item count that could be one.

many.reason: Home has no collection to overflow; the card grid is fixed at two cards with an intentionally empty third column.

loading.reason: Statically prerendered to HTML at build time, so there is no pending state to show.

error.reason: No client fetches and no user input on this page; nothing can fail at view time.

many.reason: An internal page has no item collection to overflow — the body is one continuous markdown blob that flows into the two-column grid by design, growing taller rather than truncating, so there is no distinct far-more-than-fits state to show.

loading.reason: Every page is statically prerendered to HTML at build time and fetches nothing at view time, so no pending state exists to capture.

error.reason: The page makes no client fetches and takes no user input. The one failure path — the tree regrow throwing — is caught deliberately so the server-rendered tree stands, which renders identically to the static capture and therefore has no distinct visual state.
